scope: source-first intake of special non-fruit trees; no V0 card activation

source_facts.fact: Palms occur in the Desert and on Ginger Island. Shaking or chopping can yield Coconut after Foraging level 1, and island palms can yield Golden Coconut; this source is not used here to assert a guaranteed Wood drop.

Mushroom Trees can appear on the farm when a common tree transforms in Fall; chopping gives Red or Purple Mushrooms and leaves a stump, which can regrow in Spring. Tapping is a separate source of mushrooms.
Mystic Trees grow from crafted Mystic Tree Seeds after Foraging Mastery; chopping produces Hardwood and leaves a stump. Tapping produces Mystic Syrup.

source_facts.source: Stardew Valley Wiki — Green Rain Trees
source_facts.fact: Green Rain Tree Types 1 and 2 have Wood/Sap outputs, while Type 3 has Fiddlehead Fern output; some common trees temporarily transform during Green Rain or Fall. Chopping leaves a stump.
